5.title: Three CE2134 assignments in AY2026/27 Sem 1
5.notes: The three assignments examine AI versus rule-based support, confidence improvement, and learning evidence. PSet 2 used the same assignment in both groups.

12.title: AI in my experiential learning
12.notes: I have integrated AI into my experiential learning approach, and I will continue integrating it as this approach develops. Observed student outcomes: PSet 1 had fewer reported relevance problems with AI support (0/55 off-topic or nonsense cases versus 12/54 with rule-based replies); the confidence-change difference was not statistically significant. PSet 2 mean confidence rose by 0.31 on a 1-5 scale after AI use, based on 47 paired ratings. PSet 3: 60.7% of anonymous IDs (37/61, rounded to 61% on this summary) sought conceptual help; 54.1% (33/61) had repeated AI exchanges. These are observed outcomes, not a claim of a causal AI effect.
